title: Automatic mutual recognition of occupational registrations (Western Australia)
summary: Western Australia adopted the Commonwealth AMR amendments by the Mutual Recognition (Western Australia) Amendment Act 2022 (assent 29 March 2022), with the scheme commencing in WA on 1 July 2022.

instruments.title: Mutual Recognition Amendment Act 2021
instruments.provisions: Amends Mutual Recognition Act 1992 to insert automatic deemed registration (Part 3A)

instruments.title: Mutual Recognition (Western Australia) Amendment Act 2022 Commencement Proclamation 2022

commenced.what: AMR scheme commenced in Western Australia

direction_rationale: Removes the need for a separate application and fee to work interstate, lowering the cost of entry for licensed tradespeople and agents from other participating jurisdictions; expected to increase the number of potential suppliers, especially near borders.
comparison: Queensland (never joined) and later-joining states (TAS Dec 2021, SA Feb 2022, WA Jul 2022); border vs non-border regions
confounders: occupation-specific temporary exemptions in each jurisdiction
price_series: Maintenance and repair of the dwelling; Real estate services are not a separate CPI class
notes: The 'announced' date is a WA Government release saying WA would join subject to legislation.

verified.notes: 1 Jul 2022 comes from a WA Radiological Council news item (seen in search results; page now returns 404) and matches the 2021 expected date; the commencement proclamation text was not read. A Victorian Health page instead lists 24 Mar 2022, which predates WA assent and appears wrong.
